criteria.statement: The offline command generates and rereads a deterministic GIS artifact from a repository fixture

evidence.observed: Fresh output matched committed GeoJSON and summary bytes; the core reread both files and verified the artifact SHA-256.

criteria.statement: Negative tests cover malformed geometry, missing CRS or unsafe output behavior

evidence.observed: Nine tests passed, covering malformed geometry, missing CRS, duplicate JSON keys, existing-output preservation, bounded feature counts, deterministic artifacts, benchmark correctness, CLI output and adapter syntax/evidence status.

criteria.statement: The QGIS adapter and native acceptance command are documented while native status remains NOT RUN unless observed

evidence.observed: The guide documents the Processing adapter and native_qgis_smoke.py command; T2, T3 and T4 are explicitly NOT RUN in committed offline evidence.

criteria.statement: The workflow has a copyable prompt, environment matrix and machine-readable evidence report

evidence.observed: Machine-readable T1 report is present and the workflow README includes a copyable agent request plus offline/QGIS environment matrix.
